description: Create a UML Deployment Diagram in EdrawMax for a Warehouse Management System (WMS). Start by creating a new blank diagram or using a deployment diagram template. You must create 5 device nodes: 'Client Browser', 'Web Server', 'Application Server', 'Database Server', and 'Cache Server'. Inside these nodes, deploy the following artifacts: 'Nginx Reverse Proxy' and 'WMS Frontend (React)' on the Web Server; 'WMS API (Spring Boot)', 'Inventory Service', and 'Order Processing Service' on the Application Server; 'PostgreSQL 15' and 'WMS Production Database' on the Database Server; 'Redis 7.0' and 'Session Store' on the Cache Server. Connect the nodes with communication paths labeled with these protocols: '«HTTPS»' (Client-Web), '«HTTP/REST»' (Web-App), '«JDBC/TCP:5432»' (App-DB), and '«TCP:6379»' (App-Cache). Arrange the diagram logically. Save the source file to '/home/ga/Diagrams/wms_deployment_diagram.eddx' and export a PNG image to '/home/ga/Diagrams/wms_deployment_diagram.png'.
